system.description: Whether you're acting, dancing, playing an instrument, singing, or delivering slam poetry, use this Skill when you want to electrify an audience. Choose a type of performance to specialize in as your starting type. Make an Unopposed Skill Check to determine the audience reaction. If you are competing against other performers, add the top rival's CHA to the Difficulty. On Success, you command the stage.

upgrades.description: Choose an additional type of performance to specialize in.

Choose an additional type of performance. You can coach and coordinate others in one of your specialties. After coaching them for at least 1 hour in one of your specialties, they can attempt an unskilled Performance Skill Check without Disadvantage.
Choose an additional type of performance. You can mimic someone else's performance after experiencing it once.
